scripts.//: Angular 22's prerender worker fails on Node 25 ("module is not linked"); the build runs under a pinned Node 24 fetched by npx.
scripts.build: npx -y -p node@24.22.3 node node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build && rm -rf ../../built/angular && cp -r dist/fixture/browser ../../built/angular && rm -f ../../built/angular/index.csr.html
